notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Patch 1.1 is now LIVE!

New Features
- Steam Achievements
- Steam Leaderboards

notes.title: The First Update
notes.content:
First update of many! Added a few features. I am aware of a few bugs here and there, but none that effect the main gameplay. Please let me know if you find anything game-breaking! Thank you!

New Features

Music - Lo-fi
Controls - Left-Right and Chris Mode
New Menu - Customize, Settings, Credits, and Leave Game
Removed - It


Next Update will be focused on Steam Achievements and Scoreboards if all goes well with this one.
